The graphical status falsely says g2 was repaired in place; immutable provenance and successor allocation are not represented accurately.

Core/Advanced owners describe Article 39(f) as added by the 42nd Amendment instead of substituted/recast, associate Article 40 directly with both the 73rd and 74th Amendments, and use overbroad Special Marriage Act eligibility wording.
Owner shorthand that Fundamental Rights enjoy supremacy over DPSP is too broad; the current rule requires harmony/basic-structure wording plus the specific surviving Article 31C exception.
